due_when.clears_when: comms/live_review/outcomes.jsonl holds >= 30 graded reviews with a realised-vs-hold delta, AND $/R per real-money/prop package is measured

what: LTR trigger thresholds (RQ-20261026-f50f-01) KEPT at their defaults. The registered rule needed a win at both c_R=0.02 and c_R=0.10. The 'fire less' values win 4/4 folds at c_R=0.10 and 0/4 at 0.02: the modelled value of looking is ~0 (+0.028 R over 571 OOS trades, 60% thin LTR-0 cells, 20 of 1,393 reviews acted). Two things would re-open it. (1) Measure $/R per package (sum of risk_pct x equity over the accounts carrying it, via a diag pull) to fix c_R. (2) Use graded live reviews (comms/live_review/outcomes.jsonl) to price judgement on thin cells. Then re-run the harness with the measured c_R and judgement value as a NEW registered unit.
